comment: Failure-mode catalog consumed by scripts/warpos/provider-smoke.js (T-20260513-019) and scripts/warpos/lib/provider-rca.js (T-20260513-022). Each entry maps a provider-health status to a root_cause + safe_to_autofix + fix_recipe + remediation + fallback_allowed signal. β-decided defaults applied 2026-05-13: only `trusted_directory_required` is safe_to_autofix=true; `auth_source_mismatch` is fallback_allowed=false (mirrors provider-fallback.json#do_not_fall_back).

severity_buckets.comment: Severity matches scripts/warpos/provider-smoke.js#iconFor. 'ok' is green; the three statuses above are yellow (non-blocking unless --exit-on-yellow); everything else is red.

cli_missing.root_cause: Provider CLI binary not found on PATH or not installed.
cli_missing.remediation: Install the provider CLI. claude: `npm i -g @anthropic-ai/claude-code`. openai: `npm i -g @openai/codex`. gemini: `npm i -g @google/gemini-cli`. Then re-run.

auth_missing.root_cause: Provider CLI is installed but session/login is missing or expired.
auth_missing.remediation: Authenticate the CLI interactively. claude: `claude /login`. openai: `codex login`. gemini: `gemini auth login`. Never auto-fix — interactive auth requires the operator.

auth_source_mismatch.root_cause: Both an API key env var AND CLI OAuth session are set — provider has ambiguous credential source.
auth_source_mismatch.remediation: Choose ONE credential source. Either unset the API key env var to use OAuth, or `codex logout` (etc.) to use the env key. Mirrors provider-fallback.json#do_not_fall_back to surface the ambiguity rather than silently picking.

model_not_found.root_cause: Requested model id is not in the CLI's bundled registry — usually stale CLI version.
model_not_found.remediation: Upgrade the provider CLI: `npm i -g @<vendor>/<cli>@latest`. Then re-run.

stale_cli_registry.root_cause: Provider CLI registry is older than the configured target models.
stale_cli_registry.remediation: Upgrade the provider CLI to refresh its bundled model registry: `npm i -g @<vendor>/<cli>@latest`.

trusted_directory_required.root_cause: Gemini CLI requires explicit workspace trust before probing in this directory.

fix_recipe.note: Sets GEMINI_CLI_TRUST_WORKSPACE=true in the current Node process env and re-probes once. Does NOT persist to operator shell rc files.

trusted_directory_required.remediation: Auto-fix applied. If still failing after retry, set GEMINI_CLI_TRUST_WORKSPACE=true in your shell environment permanently.

provider_timeout.root_cause: Probe wall-clock budget exceeded before provider responded.

fix_recipe.note: Network/CLI transient. One retry with the same timeout is cheap and catches most flap-class failures. T-023 owns this dispatcher.

provider_timeout.remediation: Auto-retry attempted. If still red after retry, check network and provider status.

quota_exhausted.root_cause: Provider rate limit or hard quota hit.
quota_exhausted.remediation: Wait for the quota window to reset, upgrade tier, or rely on the configured provider-fallback policy. Auto-fixing quota is not possible without billing changes.

free_tier_limit_zero.root_cause: Provider account has a free-tier daily limit of zero (account misconfiguration or expired trial).
free_tier_limit_zero.remediation: Switch the account to a paid tier, or configure the provider-fallback policy to route around this provider for non-critical roles.

unknown_error.root_cause: Unclassified provider error — likely a new failure mode not yet catalogued.
unknown_error.remediation: Inspect the smoke event in events.jsonl for full stderr (truncated 400 chars in CLI output). Consider adding a new catalog entry if this recurs.
